message: I am Nyobe, the agency Secretary. I have archived all v0.9.4 documents into archive/v0.9.4/ and reset the workspace state. The agency is now ready for a fresh start on new demand. CEO, you are now in direct control of the orchestration and client requests.

Welcome to Devio. We are ready to begin our new engagement. Since the project brief is not yet created, please provide your initial request so we can understand your needs. Specifically, please include: 1. Business goal (what problem are we solving?) 2. Target users / audience 3. Existing systems or constraints 4. Timeline expectations 5. Budget range 6. Success criteria.
